items.headline: China lets provinces tap $82B in unspent bond quota to shore up growth
items.why: Targeted fiscal stimulus signals Beijing supporting growth/liquidity into year-end, relevant to China AI-capex and risk appetite.

items.headline: OpenAI ARR: Axios (9/29) reported ~$70B; Bloomberg/FT (10/8) say investors told ~$50B at Sept-end, $70B+ targeted by year-end
items.why: Gap between scoop and investor-told figure raises growth/accounting credibility questions ahead of heavy compute spend

items.headline: Fed minutes show unanimous Sept 25bp hike to 3.75%-4.00%, but deep split on further hikes
items.why: First Fed hike since 2023; divided outlook on more tightening directly affects AI-capex financing costs and risk-asset multiples.

items.headline: DeepSeek reportedly nears $12B funding round led by Tencent, CATL ahead of 2027 IPO
items.why: Signals China's top LLM lab locking in mega capital and new backers before going public — key read on domestic AI financing depth

items.headline: AI compute startup Lambda to raise up to $4B at $14.5B pre-money valuation ahead of planned IPO
items.why: Major neocloud GPU-rental financing round signals continued capital inflow into AI compute infrastructure outside hyperscalers

items.headline: Nvidia faces scrutiny over AI chips reaching China via smuggling scheme, per US prosecutors' evidence
items.why: Raises enforcement/compliance risk around export controls and Nvidia's China exposure, a persistent overhang on the stock

items.headline: OpenAI reportedly in talks to raise $30B at $1.4T valuation
items.why: Would roughly double OpenAI's ~$852B March valuation, resetting the benchmark for private AI-lab valuations ahead of any IPO.
